one_shot_complete_phase_planning.admission_rule: Evaluate the full expression once using factual measurements and all remaining work; compare cumulatively with both authorized powered-time and monetary limits. Do not omit benchmarks or seek repeated per-arm exceptions.
one_shot_complete_phase_planning.compression_or_faster_export: Potential improvements require representative actual full-state compression ratios, compression/decompression time, integrity checks and end-to-end durable throughput measurements. No saving is assumed; neither has resolved the current admission gap.

one_shot_complete_phase_planning.hypothetical_12h_remainder_scope: Approximately 3.08 hours before subtracting already-used setup, for all other work after the 1.3 factor. Whether it suffices is unknown because no GPU preflight ran.
